title: Professional Certificate Course in Concepts in Implementing Strategies
description: In this course, you will learn what makes a strategy acceptable for all stakeholders.
longDescription: Understand the nature of strategy implementation and different perspectives on strategy implementation. Elaborate roles and functions of the different departments during strategy implementation. Explain the role of research and development in sustainable strategy formulation. Understand how to integrate implementation with the strategic objective of a business. Join this course and gain a comprehensive understanding of how strategy contributes to business success. You will explore the process and different levels of strategy formulation, from analyzing the industry and competitive landscape to defining the company's vision, mission, and goals. You will also learn about the Strategy-Formulation Analytical Framework, a powerful tool to help you analyze and evaluate strategic alternatives. One critical factor in strategy formulation is the culture aspects of strategy choice. You will learn how to navigate cultural differences and understand how culture shapes the strategic direction of a company. Politics can also play a role in strategy choice. You will explore the politics of strategy and gain insights into how to overcome the challenges and obstacles that arise in the process.
